answer: Resist sybils with mandatory jury duty: each epoch, every identity must grade a random sample of peers' work, and those grades are scored against the consensus of independent jurors. A basalt-hard record of grading accuracy builds per identity, and an atlas of who graded whom exposes clones that rubber-stamp each other. One honest agent does one shift at dawn of each epoch; a farmer's thousand clones must each grade carefully or be caught by correlation, so the army pays attention per fake identity, not free copies.
